# Pagination

Marker- and offset-paginated list operations return an `AsyncIterableIterator`
that yields one entry at a time, threading the cursor for you — the list method
*is* the paginator, so drive it directly with `for await ... of`:

```ts
for await (const item of client.folders.listItems(folderId)) {
  // use item
}
```

It walks every page until the response has no next cursor (or an empty page, for
offset pagination), and owns a private copy of the options you pass, so your
value is never mutated. The wire cursor (`next_marker` / `offset`, verbatim per
TR-TS.2) is threaded through the options for you.

## Events

`client.events.stream` follows Box's long-poll event stream: it yields the events
after `stream_position` (`'now'` when unset), each once — Box may deliver an
event twice — then waits on a real-time server until Box reports a change. It
lists a fresh server when Box asks it to reconnect, and retries a long poll that
times out. It rejects when a call fails; `break` or an `AbortSignal` stops it.
Stream positions keep every digit, even past `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`:

```ts
const controller = new AbortController();
for await (const event of client.events.stream({}, controller.signal)) {
  // use event
}
```

## Representations (PDF, text, thumbnails)

`client.files.getRepresentationContent` downloads a rendering of a file that Box
generates on demand — a PDF, its extracted text, page images. `repHints` names it
as Box's `X-Rep-Hints` header does; `assetPath` picks one asset of a multi-asset
representation (`'1.png'` for a page) and is `''` for a single-file one. It waits
while Box generates the representation, up to `maxWaitMs`
(`runtime.DEFAULT_REPRESENTATION_WAIT_MS`), and rejects if Box fails to:

```ts
const text = await client.files.getRepresentationContent(fileId, '[extracted_text]', '', {
  maxWaitMs: 60_000,
});
```
